train: Original train partition, excluding every reserved localization worker
development: Original dev partition, excluding every reserved localization worker
reservation: Original test and all three reserved localization workers remain unused in this development experiment
families: Training intent and ordered slot roles only; values remain varying targets. No semantic vocabulary in the engine.
selection: Highest exact development matches, then fewest rules, then policy order
normalization: Lowercase, collapse whitespace, remove terminal .?! from utterance and slot values. No translation, dictionaries, LLM or semantic preprocessing.
metrics: Exact intent plus all ordered slot values; intention alone and slots alone reported separately. Abstentions remain in every denominator.
scope: Prospective development diagnostic, not a full M1 acceptance contract. No claim that intent/slot extraction is general comprehension. RSS, energy and LLM comparisons unavailable. Inference/labels separated logically, not by an OS sandbox.
